title: Pro Tip: Why Correct Drain Slope Matters
description: Achieving the correct slope on horizontal drainage pipes is critical for self-scouring flow. A common amateur mistake during rough-in plumbing is assuming a steeper pipe pitch is always superior. If a horizontal drain pipe is pitched too steeply, liquids flow rapidly away, leaving solid waste stranded inside the pipe. Conversely, inadequate slope causes standing water and heavy sediment accumulation. Plumbers maintain the standard quarter-inch per foot drop, subject to local plumbing codes, ensuring liquids and solids travel through the line together effectively.
